newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Esso Malaysia has 6-mth record sales.
newsitem.headline: Esso Malaysia has 6-mth record sales.

text.p: Esso Malaysia Bhd Bhd said on Monday that a 23 percent rise in six-month revenue to 1.01 billion ringgit reflected a record sales volume of 82,000 barrels per day.

In a statement releasing its earnings for the first half of 1996, the oil concern said its sales volume was about 19 percent higher than the first half of 1995. Improved product prices also contributed to the stronger turnover, it said.
Esso posted a 28 percent rise in net profit to 37.91 million ringgit for the first half of 1996.

"The better results were due to higher refining and sales volumes coupled with slightly improved refining margins. The gains were partially offset by higher taxes," said Esso Malaysia chairman Philip Dingle in the statement.
Dingle said the company's refinery in Port Dickson, on the west coast of Peninsular Malaysia, continued to operate at near capacity levels.
"Refining margins in the region did improve compared to 1995, but continue to be below historical levels," Dingle said.
